decisions.reason: Changing the tutorial video's hosting channel does not alter the measurement sequence or its instructions.
The source changes where a video will be hosted, not Android localization coverage, language count, or localized content behavior.
The source changes where a video will be hosted, not iOS localization coverage, language coverage, or localized content behavior.
Uploading instructional media to the client's YouTube channel does not change the existing requirement that social-media links resolve correctly.
The hosting-channel decision does not change the requirement to localize every social-media link.
The source Requirement already specifies external streaming; selecting the client's YouTube channel does not change Android size goals or asset optimization strategy.
The video's hosting channel has no effect on the policy or identified work concerning unused Android permissions.
The hosting-channel choice does not modify Android framework compatibility, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
Selecting the client's YouTube channel for externally delivered media does not change iOS size goals or localized asset strategy.
The hosting-channel decision does not alter iOS framework modernization, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The source does not change the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The video's hosting channel has no effect on iOS signing certificates or submission signing configuration.
